sections.title: 2.2 Human Strategy Learning via Imitation Learning

abstract_sentences.text: Human mobility trajectory data supports a wide range of applications, including urban planning, intelligent transportation systems, and public safety monitoring.
However, large-scale, high-quality mobility datasets are difficult to obtain due to privacy concerns.

evidence.anchor: difficult to obtain due to privacy concerns

abstract_sentences.text: Raw trajectory data may reveal sensitive user information, such as home addresses, routines, or social relationships, making it crucial to develop privacy-preserving alternatives.
Recent advances in deep generative modeling have enabled synthetic trajectory generation, but existing methods either lack formal privacy guarantees or suffer from reduced utility and scalability.
Differential Privacy (DP) has emerged as a rigorous framework for data protection, and recent efforts such as PATE-GAN and PateGAIL integrate DP with generative adversarial learning.
While promising, these methods struggle to generalize across diverse trajectory patterns and often incur significant utility degradation.

evidence.anchor: struggle to generalize across diverse trajectory patterns

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we propose a new framework that builds on PateGAIL++ by introducing a sensitivity-aware noise injection module that dynamically adjusts privacy noise based on sample-level sensitivity.
This design significantly improves trajectory fidelity, downstream task performance, and scalability under strong privacy guarantees.

evidence.anchor: improves trajectory fidelity, downstream task performance, and scalability

abstract_sentences.text: We further adapt our framework to the local differential privacy (LDP) setting, allowing individual-level protection without reliance on a trusted server.
We evaluate our method on a real-world mobility dataset and demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art baselines in terms of privacy-utility trade-off.

evidence.anchor: demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art baselines
Human mobility data supports a wide range of critical applications

method_moves.answer: Inverse confidence margin defines sensitivity; pilot reward defines per-sample ε; budgets sum to ε.

method_moves.answer: Users perturb rewards locally and allocate per-user budgets; homomorphic encryption is suggested for weights.

evidence.anchor: often produces vanishing gradients and unstable updates

method_moves.answer: Replaces cross-entropy discriminator with WGAN-GP critic and optional spectral normalization.

method_moves.answer: Smoother rewards and more stable aggregation/policy updates.

lexical_analysis.interpretation: Domain terms drive frequencies, especially privacy, trajectory, noise and sensitivity. Guarantee, state-of-the-art and consistently occur in stronger prose than their direct evidence coverage.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 uniform privacy noise 改成 discriminator-derived trajectory sensitivity 驱动的 per-sample/per-user Laplace budget，在 federated imitation learning 中追求 utility–privacy trade-off；WGAN-GP 用于 adaptive-noise 稳定性，central 版本延伸到 LDP。证据位于 p. 2、p. 5–6、p. 8。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题定义、Fig. 2 边界、sensitivity/ε 公式、Laplace aggregation、WGAN-GP objective、PPO、五项 JSD、Geolife MIA、Telecom utility、LDP Table 7 和 baseline caveat；未保留完整 DP accounting、seed、训练预算、下游任务或 runtime/scaling measurements（p. 3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录放置 baseline 定义、Telecom MIA、best-λGP Fig. 3、user-subset Table 10、ethics/reproducibility。核心 Geolife/LDP 决策仍可读，但跨分布、参与度和最优 λGP 判断依赖 p. 14–16；A.1 的完整配置声明在 PDF 中缺少具体表格。
final_judgment.best_pattern: C1–C3 challenge 与组件一一对应，再以 matched-noise Table 2–3、privacy Table 4–5、LDP Table 7 逐层展开；Fig. 2 降低 federated boundary 成本，Eq. (6–8) 统一 central/compensation/LDP 记号，Table 2 的约 29% DailyLoc 对比最易复述（p. 4、p. 8）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: formal (ε,δ)-DP guarantee 没有 theorem/proof、pilot mechanism、composition、Δf、δ 或 sensitivity bound；Telecom 与 LiRA 表格和“consistently/stronger”总括不一致；downstream/scalability 没有直接测量。命名 PG、PATEGAIL+++、PATEGAIL++− 与 λGP=0/1 冲突增加读者成本（p. 5–6、p. 8–10、p. 15–16）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 每个 adaptive privacy 或 training 组件都配一张固定预算、固定评测协议的独立对照表，并公开 sensitivity、composition、攻击重复和分母；跨数据集结论逐项保留异质性，不用单一最佳行代表整体（p. 7–10、p. 15）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于含 privacy budget、adaptive noise、federated aggregation 或多阶段训练的生成模型论文。纯理论论文可将对照表替换为 theorem/assumption/composition/failure-boundary 证明；不同分母的 utility 与 attack 不应合并为一个 frontier。
